# Quite Apps

> Free, open-source Chrome extensions from an independent UK studio. Remove YouTube ads and clear your Facebook feed. One permission each, no tracking.

We are a small independent studio in the UK. We make Chrome extensions that take things away rather than add them — and we publish the source, so you never have to take our word for what they do.

## Extensions

- [Quite for YouTube](https://quiteapps.co.uk/extensions/quite-for-youtube/): Skips video ads and hides the ad panels in your feed, sidebar, search results and Shorts — without tripping YouTube's anti-adblock check. Free, MIT licensed. Source: https://github.com/KingDogma23/yt-ad-cleaner
  - Permissions: storage, *://*.youtube.com/*
  - Version 0.20.8, updated 27 August 2026. Runs on Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc, Opera, Vivaldi.
- [Quite for Facebook](https://quiteapps.co.uk/extensions/quite-for-facebook/): Hides ads, suggested posts, suggested groups and the Sponsored column, and leaves your friends' posts exactly where they were. Free, MIT licensed. Source: https://github.com/KingDogma23/fb-feed-cleaner
  - Permissions: storage, *://*.facebook.com/*
  - Version 2.5.4, updated 27 August 2026. Runs on Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc, Opera, Vivaldi.

## How the extensions are distributed

Not on the Chrome Web Store. Both install unpacked: download the folder from
GitHub, open chrome://extensions, turn on Developer mode, and use Load unpacked.

## Privacy

- [Privacy](https://quiteapps.co.uk/privacy/): No analytics, no cookies, no accounts, no servers.
  Each extension runs only on the single site it is for and stores nothing beyond
  your own settings, in your own browser.
